scope: Outstanding user requirements for integration-owner verification; this is not the final verification.json and does not predict results of a later run.

requirements.requirement: A real complex task remains continuous through failure, repair/review revision, compaction with source recovery and a Core restart, and ultimately completes with real artifacts and trustworthy evidence.
requirements.current_evidence: The strict earlier L1 pass has live self-repair/revision but no compaction/restart. Retained L2/L3 through the v6 runs stop before successful dependent execution. Plan-boundary restart alone is insufficient.
requirements.needed: A later run's actual accepted final state, settled model/tool receipts, current artifact hash bindings, independent review, compaction/source readback and observed mid-execution restart continuity must all be checked. Root must substitute its final run evidence.

requirements.requirement: Determine actual model context/output capability and service rate/concurrency/token constraints, keeping proxy transport, upstream execution and correct answer distinct.
requirements.current_evidence: Small protocol probes exist. Context 65536, output 8192/1024 and concurrency two are operator bounds or tested cases, not actual service maxima. Upstream identity remains proxy-reported and unverified; price and true rate limit are unknown.
requirements.needed: Trusted provider/service documentation or bounded direct measurements before claiming real service maxima. Unknown price/identity must remain unknown.

requirements.requirement: Planner can replan the unfinished running DAG after a failure while completed nodes, receipts and executed external effects remain intact.
requirements.current_evidence: Goal changes and new DAG proposals are constrained to proposed/awaiting-approval Quests. Approved team replacement preserves the existing DAG; it is not general remaining-DAG replanning.
requirements.needed: A minimal governed running-plan revision protocol and tests/live evidence preserving all prior work; no historical plan mutation.

requirements.requirement: Bounded specialist/hierarchical expansion, model replacement and unfinished-node reassignment work during execution without losing completed work or uncertain effects.
requirements.current_evidence: Composition algorithms and approval-bound replacement have local regression. General hierarchical expansion is incomplete and the retained complex live attempts have not established the complete adaptive path.
requirements.needed: Explicit bounded hierarchy/expansion contracts and a real adaptive run with historical identity, approval, evidence and budget preservation.

requirements.requirement: Semantic retrieval complements keyword, Quest, time, reliability/conflict and expiry filtering.
requirements.current_evidence: Recall uses lexical terms and bounded bilingual aliases; its source-ID/hash dataset is exploratory. No embedding or learned semantic retrieval is implemented.
requirements.needed: A sourced semantic index plus independent retrieval evaluation using source identities and task relevance, not summary similarity alone.

requirements.requirement: Workers read, modify and test code and perform reproducible experiments with real execution and bounded self-correction.
requirements.current_evidence: Current tools provide file creation, own-latest-artifact revision, syntax checks and a fixed pure numeric AST subset. They do not provide arbitrary shell, unrestricted Python, general repository patching or arbitrary test commands. The narrow scheduler experiment cannot establish general software development.
requirements.needed: Governed tool support and actual tests for the broader claimed scope, or a clear delivery statement limiting support to the implemented subset.

requirements.requirement: Every Worker submits all eight structured delivery fields.
requirements.current_evidence: Review criteria enforce the eight fields and record actual supplied fields. Default/legacy compatibility output schemas still require only summary, so universal enforcement is not established.
requirements.needed: An explicitly versioned approval/compatibility policy and checks for every relevant contract, without inventing omitted model fields or silently expanding old approvals.

requirements.requirement: Agent communication uses durable structured task, help, review/revision, dependency, model, budget and failure messages rather than free-text coordination.
requirements.current_evidence: The durable event/outbox transport and typed projection validate task identity and map ten message types. AgentMessage.payload remains a dict; exhaustive independent schema validation of every message-specific payload is incomplete.
requirements.needed: Per-type payload contracts and compatibility/adversarial checks for the fields actually consumed by Router/Worker coordination.

requirements.requirement: Task/tool success, retry, schema compliance, latency, token/cost and review-pass measurements have source, sample count, time and uncertainty separated from manual priors.
requirements.current_evidence: Online execution observations and confidence-aware inputs exist, while the single local target profile uses manual exploratory priors. Small transport samples are not broad capability estimates; many requested quality/cost statistics remain unmeasured.
requirements.needed: Multiple independently scored task outcomes by capability and reliable cost data before claiming measured general model skill or full performance coverage.

requirements.requirement: Team composition, context compression and governance compare the requested variants on multiple domains/difficulties with fixed datasets, common budgets and independent scoring of task success, cost, latency, tokens, rework and evidence completeness.
requirements.current_evidence: The fixed offline benchmark has synthetic profiles, extractive context baselines, counterfactual governance ablations and real local tools under Mock fixtures. These are explicitly exploratory and make zero Provider calls. Same-budget live quality/governance comparisons and generalization are unmeasured.
requirements.needed: A real-model benchmark with separately scored task quality and actual usage, preserved failed runs, comparable budgets and modest small-sample conclusions.

requirements.requirement: Task handling covers multimodal work and multiple parallel Quests without unnecessarily splitting simple chat.
requirements.current_evidence: The retained acceptance scenarios use bounded local text/code sources and one Quest per workspace. They do not establish actual multimodal input execution or simultaneous multi-Quest autonomous completion.
requirements.needed: Purpose-specific real end-to-end scenarios and capability-compatible models; route classification alone is insufficient.

requirements.requirement: Restart recovery preserves task continuity and historical side effects without replaying unknown remote outcomes.
requirements.current_evidence: Leases, receipts, checkpoint/source recovery and bounded semantic/review callbacks are tested locally. Arbitrary in-flight external effects and unknown remote model outcomes remain fenced/reserved; no per-attempt operator reconciliation interface exists. Safe refusal is intentional and is not proof of general autonomous recovery.
requirements.needed: Exact-boundary live restart evidence for supported cases, and a trusted reconciliation mechanism before expanding claims to unknown effects.

reporting_rules: Root must bind final full-suite and live outcomes to its final source snapshot; v6 diagnostics are not results for later code.
Retain all failed protocol/task runs in their appropriate denominator and preserve unknown reservations.
Do not count overlapping focused test groups as one aggregate full-suite total.
Same-model fresh-context review satisfies the implemented context-isolation boundary; a different reviewer model is a possible limitation, not an additional user-mandated hard requirement.
Authenticated plan/team/tool approval remains intentional. Removing it would violate the user's approval/policy constraints.
Deferred UI/installer/native packaging work is outside this Sprint's requested main acceptance scope.
